<p>DualBird Inc., a startup using customizable field-programmable gate arrays to speed up data processing workloads, today announced that it has raised $25 million in funding. Lightspeed Venture Partners led the investment. It was joined by Bessemer Venture Partners, Angular Ventures and Uncork Capital. DualBird will use the funds to accelerate its go-to-market efforts.
